worldcombat.skill.snowscape.summary: Drop a quiet snow onto the chosen ground: it covers the surface, locks open water into ice, and Ice bodies inside brace their Defense a stage higher. It deals no damage.
worldcombat.skill.snowscape.use.0: Lay snow and lock water to change the footing
worldcombat.skill.snowscape.use.2: Prepare ground for later Ice moves and movement
Drop snow of radius %1$s blocks onto the chosen ground, lasting %2$s.
Covers up to %1$s ground cells and freezes %2$s water cells; snow clings for %3$s after leaving.
worldcombat.skill.snowscape.timing: Cast at ground within %1$s blocks; after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP to drop the snow, recovers %3$s, and commits a %5$s cooldown on cast.
worldcombat.skill.snowscape.growth.0: At level %1$s the committed cooldown drops to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.snowscape.growth.1: At level %1$s the committed cooldown drops again to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.snowscape.preference.d: On = deep cover: wider snow (x1.15), more ground cover (x1.35), more water frozen (x1.4) and longer cling (x1.3), but shorter life (x0.8) and cooldown +14 ticks. Off = light snow: smaller and thinner cover, but lasts longer (x1.2) and cools down 10 ticks sooner.
worldcombat.skill.snowscape.preference.a: The companion only calls snow while a threat is within this distance; lower drops it up close, higher sets it up in advance.
Push the snow at the foe
On, the snow is laid between you and the threat so the fighting line falls in it; off, it is laid at your feet to shield yourself first.
On, a companion holding its station will step out to call snow.
